title: Official OpenAI .NET SDK (v2.x) Architecture
description: Master the official OpenAI .NET SDK v2.x: ChatClient, System.ClientModel primitives, ChatCompletionOptions, and token monitoring.

data.text: The official OpenAI .NET SDK (developed jointly by OpenAI and Microsoft) represents a ground-up redesign of AI client libraries in .NET. Built on modern System.ClientModel primitives, it delivers zero-allocation streaming, strongly-typed domain clients (ChatClient, EmbeddingClient, AudioClient, RealtimeClient), and native support for the latest model capabilities including structured outputs, vision, and audio reasoning.

data.title: Prompt Tuning Controls
items: Temperature (0.0 - 2.0): Controls randomness. Use 0.0 - 0.2 for deterministic code/JSON extraction; 0.7 - 1.0 for creative copy.
TopP (Nucleus Sampling): Alternative to temperature; limits sampling to top cumulative probability mass. Prefer adjusting either Temperature or TopP, not both.
MaxOutputTokenCount: Hard ceiling on tokens generated. Protects against runaway costs and response truncation.
StopSequences: Custom string tokens that immediately halt generation when emitted (e.g. ['\n---', 'END_OF_TRANSCRIPT']).

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: The official OpenAI .NET SDK v2.x provides modular, lightweight domain clients (ChatClient, EmbeddingClient)
Built on System.ClientModel for high performance and low allocation overhead
Inspect ClientResult<ChatCompletion>.Value.Usage for granular input and output token counts
Tune Temperature and MaxOutputTokenCount to control randomness and prevent cost overruns
Seamlessly transitions to Azure OpenAI via Azure.AI.OpenAI with identical API structures
data.takeaway: The OpenAI .NET SDK v2.x is the bedrock of modern C# AI engineering, combining raw performance with clean, idiomatic .NET patterns.
